title: Knowledge assistant
description: Answers staff questions from the staff handbook and cites the section each answer comes from.

spec.input: A staff question in plain language
spec.output: Short answer with section citations and quotes

problem: Staff answer routine questions by searching a long handbook or asking the practice manager. The manager is interrupted many times a day, and answers given from memory are not always the same as the handbook.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: A staff member asks a question in Teams.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude searches the staff handbook from SharePoint and writes a short answer from the relevant sections only.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Every answer cites the section and quotes the handbook. If the handbook does not cover the question, it says so and names who to ask.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: The answer and citations appear in the Teams chat.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Answers from the handbook only and cites the sections it used.

stack.name: SharePoint
stack.role: Holds the current staff handbook, the single source for answers.

stack.name: Teams
stack.role: Where staff ask questions and read answers, through a Copilot Studio agent.

stack.name: Microsoft 365
stack.role: Staff accounts and permissions, so only staff can ask.

tryIt.placeholder: Ask a question about the staff handbook…
